rig.isolation: docker --network none --privileged; veth between two network namespaces; static neighbour entries both ways; the kernel answers as responders through AnyIP local routes
rig.dense_e2e: responders 198.18.0.0/15 x ports 80/443/8080/8443 = 524,288 targets; e1 one probe, e2 two probes; at most 524,288 keys held, so the window never fills
rig.sparse_e2e: responders on AnyIP routes for 190 /8s (1-126, 128-191); zmap -w over the same /8s and -n caps targets; s1 = 1,048,576 targets (window fills at 1,000,000 then evicts 48,576), s3 = 4,194,304 (steady state through eviction); seed 4242, 1 probe, 100,000 pps
rig.allocator: s1 with LD_PRELOAD of libjemalloc2 5.3.0-1 or libmimalloc2.0 2.0.9+ds-2 on both arms
rig.reclaim: s1 and s3; EXPANSE-reclaim swaps in the reclaim build, EXPANSE-ctrl a byte-identical copy of the shipped library, as a build control

preregistration.frozen: each study's hypotheses and thresholds were written before its first run
preregistration.H-sparse: EXPANSE - STOCK peak RSS BCa 95% lower bound >= +5 MB on s1 and s3, both runs
preregistration.H-alloc: with jemalloc and with mimalloc, EXPANSE - STOCK lower bound >= +5 MB on s1, both runs
preregistration.H-reclaim: EXPANSE-reclaim - EXPANSE-ctrl upper bound <= -1.5 MB on s1, both runs; s3 reported, not gated
preregistration.pairing_rule_disclosure: the sparse pre-registration did not state how rounds pair when a cell is void; pairing on rounds where both compared arms are admissible was set after the void cells were seen and before any interval was computed

admissibility: a cell is void if pcap_drop + pcap_ifdrop > 0 or validation_passed differs from packets_sent by more than 0.1%; void cells are disclosed, not replaced

estimators.interval: BCa 95% bootstrap over per-round paired differences

load_snapshots: each cell carries load_before (1/5/15-minute load average) and host_busy_core_eq (busy-CPU delta in core-equivalents) taken before it
